global_forbidden: text, letters, numbers, arrows, logos or pseudo-writing
baked cast shadows or contact shadows
glow, bloom, rays or temporary FX

era_contract.character: interchangeable operator components, aligned factory families, safer standardized emergency controls and machine-assisted operation
